# PR #248 round 2 — performance PASS WITH NOTES

Head: de0296290966cf936c86e454bd9cebf1cbd949b1
Request: 01a1f174-4e47-7ce3-8bd0-727dd4d7c633
Reviewer: pij-vast-silkworm, performance/248
Basis: delta only from2bfd4dcbb779a4847b07738d772ba0c9686e741e, read with `git diff` in /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/review-248-de02962. Worktree HEAD observed equal to the full requested head. Final review under C34; no local build/test, daemon bounce or code change.

## Decision

No blocking normal-use correctness or performance finding in the delta. R248-1's physical-parent placement is fixed by canonicalizing an existing start before walking ancestors. The two symlink regressions compare the resulting B/.git key directly with git. Existing common-dir canonicalization remains, so aliases such as macOS /tmp -> /private/tmp converge to the same physical git common directory rather than split keys. Missing start still returns NotARepo before canonicalization, so repo() still uses its original folder key. pa_presence and shim continue to share the same placement helper. This is placement POLICY, not a brake.

## Incremental cost

- One additional start-path canonicalization per placement of an existing directory, performed in process. This is added to the already-existing canonical(common-dir) on successful repository placement; it is not a git subprocess.
- Existing 60-second scheduler and caller multiplicity unchanged: about P*(N+1)+N quiet-path calls, O((P+1)*N*D), plus event-triggered calls described in round1. No per-round dedup was added or claimed. Cost documentation now exposes the per-PA multiplier.
- Normal checkout/worktree/non-repository folders still launch0 git processes from boot. Only Unknown follows the unchanged counted/resolved git fallback, at most once per folder per600s in serialized rounds. Canonicalization failures/non-NotFound metadata errors become Unknown rather than pretending a known placement; no added launch site.
- Pointer hardening adds a metadata check before reading commondir. `small_text` refuses stationary non-regular files and metadata length>4096 before open, reads at most4097 bytes with take(), rejects over-cap and non-UTF8 contents, and reads only one gitdir pointer plus one commondir. This bounds regular-file read/memory cost even if a file grows after stat. FIFO/oversized cases go to the existing Unknown fallback rather than blocking/unbounded in-process reads.
- New `mkfifo` subprocesses are test-only under cfg(test), not daemon launch sites. Production delta uses canonicalize/metadata/File::open/Read only. Existing spawn_sites coverage remains applicable.

## Verification actually inspected

`gh pr view248 --json headRefOid,statusCheckRollup` reports this exact head. Latest rust-test, rust-lint, check(22), check(24), and delivers are SUCCESS; an earlier delivers is CANCELLED. No local checks were rerun.

Downloaded CI run44437133490 artifact14489940606 (created2026-11-19T01:33:03Z); its workflow_run.head_sha is the exact reviewed head. Its JUnit records executed PASS for all seven relevant tests:
- place_names_the_common_dir_git_names (includes the two new symlink cases)
- place_leaves_what_it_cannot_read_to_git (includes FIFO/oversized .git and commondir cases)
- a_recreated_worktree_is_placed_in_its_new_repository_at_once
- the_presence_checks_and_placing_folders_launch_nothing
- shim_sessions_emits_the_frozen_legacy_names_and_resolves_git_common_dir
- every_daemon_launch_site_records_itself
- no_daemon_launch_searches_path_for_git_or_tmux

The downloaded artifact also retains the known unrelated staged_submit_excludes_human_input_mid_body_and_before_enter failure. The requester reports its rerun passed, and the current rust-test check is SUCCESS. I do not mislabel that artifact as an all-green suite or rerun the reported flake. CI proof is Linux; no new macOS candidate runtime proof is claimed.

CI rust-test: https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/44437133490/job/135270950513

## Remaining deployment receipt, unchanged

Deploy owner owes candidate commit/PID/uptime and git.pa-watchdog-common-dir counter at boot and again after>600 seconds, plus just spawn-rate --seconds20 and paired daemon counter/CPU-time/RSS receipts. Expected normal-layout counter absent/0 from boot. Baseline already preserved in round1: old deployed8863651685, PID61945, uptime23:21->23:41, git28->28/all781->781 over20.016s; whole machine160.9 launches/s, not attributed to this site. No candidate speedup/CPU reduction is asserted without deployment.

The separately requested CPU investigation is published as performance note1b40327fec6519c596a7776c4e24e6b997e5474e, subject daemon:pid-61945-cpu. It identifies Unisphere discovery/cards work on the old daemon; it is not evidence that this PR introduces that work. No new PR248 blocker is inferred from that independent issue.
